sink--verb.def: To go down below the surface of water.

limit--noun.def: The greatest amount that is allowed or possible.
limit--noun.ex: The speed limit here is fifty.

limit--verb.def: To keep something below a certain amount.
limit--verb.ex: Limit your answer to one page.

patrol--noun.def: A group that moves around an area to guard it.

circus--noun.def: A travelling show with clowns and acrobats.

mud--noun.ex: His boots were thick with mud.

occasion--noun.def: A particular time when something happens.

occasion--verb.def: To cause something to happen, in formal English.

ad--noun.def: A short notice that tries to sell something.
ad--noun.ex: I saw the ad on the bus.

signature--noun.def: Your name written by you on a document.

monitor--noun.def: A screen that shows information from a computer.

monitor--verb.def: To watch something carefully over time.

yell--noun.ex: We heard a yell from below.

resist--verb.def: To fight against something, or to stop yourself.
resist--verb.ex: I could not resist the cake.

fantasy--noun.def: A pleasant situation you imagine but is not real.
fantasy--noun.ex: Winning the cup was pure fantasy.

passport--noun.def: The official document you need to travel abroad.

hammer--noun.def: A tool with a heavy head for hitting nails.

charm--noun.def: The quality of being pleasant and attractive.
charm--noun.ex: The old town has real charm.
charm--noun.exTr: Eski şehrin gerçek bir cazibesi var.

previous--adj.ex: The previous owner painted it green.

deaf--adj.ex: He has been deaf since childhood.

humanity--noun.def: All people, or the quality of being kind.

producer--noun.def: A person who makes films, or a country that grows goods.
producer--noun.ex: The film's producer raised the money.

extreme--adj.def: Very great in degree, or far from normal.

oxygen--noun.def: The gas in air that living things need.

gene--noun.def: The part of a cell that passes on features to children.

minor--adj.ex: It was only a minor injury.

chaos--noun.ex: The snow caused chaos on the roads.

stubborn--adj.ex: He is too stubborn to apologize.

intense--adj.ex: The heat was intense at noon.

terrorist--noun.def: A person who uses violence for political aims.

angle--noun.def: The space between two lines that meet.
angle--noun.ex: Cut the board at a sharp angle.

invitation--noun.def: A written or spoken request to come somewhere.

respond--verb.def: To answer, or to react to something.
respond--verb.ex: She responded to my letter quickly.

absolute--adj.def: Complete and total, with no limit.
absolute--adj.ex: I need absolute quiet to study.
absolute--adj.exTr: Ders çalışmak için mutlak sessizliğe ihtiyacım var.

tragedy--noun.def: A very sad event, or a serious play.
tragedy--noun.ex: The fire was a terrible tragedy.

stable--adj.def: Not likely to change or fall.

session--noun.def: A period of time used for one activity.
session--noun.ex: The training session lasts an hour.

capture--noun.def: The act of catching a person or taking a place.

capture--verb.def: To catch someone, or to take control of a place.
capture--verb.ex: Soldiers captured the hill at dawn.

stretch--verb.def: To make something longer, or to reach out your body.
stretch--verb.ex: Stretch your arms above your head.

unable--adj.def: Not having the power or skill to do something.

increase--noun.def: A rise in number, amount or size.
increase--noun.ex: There was a sharp increase in sales.

meanwhile--adv.def: During the same period of time.
meanwhile--adv.ex: Meanwhile, the soup was boiling over.

shocked--adj.ex: Everyone was shocked by the news.

commercial--adj.def: Relating to business and making money.

academy--noun.def: A school that teaches one subject, or a learned society.
academy--noun.ex: She trained at a music academy.

hop--noun.def: A short jump on one foot.
hop--noun.ex: The bird crossed with a hop.

transport--noun.def: The system of moving people or goods.

destruction--noun.def: The act of damaging something completely.

lightning--noun.def: The bright flash of light in a storm.

instance--noun.ex: This is the third instance this month.

exhausted--adj.ex: We were exhausted after the climb.

pin--verb.def: To fasten something with a pin.
pin--verb.ex: She pinned the note to the board.

experienced--adj.def: Having done something many times before.

necklace--noun.def: A piece of jewellery worn around the neck.

loyalty--noun.def: The quality of always supporting someone.
loyalty--noun.ex: His loyalty was never in doubt.

southern--adj.def: In or from the south of a place.

liver--noun.def: The large organ that cleans the blood.

surgeon--noun.def: A doctor who operates on people.

jazz--noun.def: A style of music with a strong free rhythm.
jazz--noun.ex: He plays jazz on Friday nights.

typical--adj.def: Showing the usual qualities of a group.
typical--adj.ex: It was a typical winter day.

rubbish--noun.def: Waste material, or nonsense, in British English.
rubbish--noun.ex: Put the rubbish in the bin.

powder--noun.def: A dry substance made of very fine grains.
powder--noun.ex: Mix the powder with warm water.

pole--noun.def: A long thin post, or one end of the earth.
pole--noun.ex: The flag hangs from a tall pole.

moral--noun.def: The lesson that a story teaches.
moral--noun.ex: The moral of the tale is patience.

award--verb.def: To officially give someone a prize or money.

intention--noun.ex: He had no intention of leaving.

active--adj.def: Busy doing things, or currently working.
active--adj.ex: She stays active in her eighties.

safely--adv.def: Without being harmed or causing harm.

internal--adj.def: Inside a body, a country or an organization.
internal--adj.ex: The report is for internal use.

talented--adj.def: Having a natural skill for something.
talented--adj.ex: She is a talented young singer.

aid--noun.def: Help, especially money or supplies sent to people.
aid--noun.ex: Aid reached the village by truck.

aid--verb.def: To help someone, in a formal style.

divine--adj.def: Coming from or relating to God.
divine--adj.ex: They saw it as divine help.
divine--adj.exTr: Bunu ilahi bir yardım olarak gördüler.

objection--noun.def: A reason for disagreeing with something.
